security_audit.summary: All 123 static alerts are false positives caused by escaped HTML rendering, JavaScript template literals, Markdown, relative links, and documented provider API examples. One high-severity concern remains: voice-cloning guidance does not require consent or authorization, which can enable impersonation. No prompt injection or credential exfiltration evidence was found.

remediation.issue: Voice-cloning instructions do not require the depicted person's authorization.
remediation.suggestion: Require documented consent, identity-rights review, and synthetic-media disclosure. Refuse cloning when the user cannot establish authorization.

content.user_title: Create Grounded Ad Creative at Scale
content.value_statement: Ad teams need many platform-ready variations without losing evidence, brand fit, or review clarity. This skill creates grounded copy, concepts, test plans, and review pages.
actual_capabilities: Generates headlines, descriptions, primary text, and complete variations for major paid advertising platforms.
Checks copy against documented platform character limits and format requirements.
Analyzes provided performance data to identify winning themes and create controlled iterations.
Builds grounded static concept batches from winning ads, reviews, comments, and brand assets.
Creates evidence-ranked creative roadmaps, testing plans, iteration logs, and retrospective summaries.
Populates a self-contained HTML review page for stakeholder comparison and approval.
limitations: It cannot retrieve campaign performance without configured external tools, credentials, and user approval.
Output quality depends on accurate product context, customer evidence, brand guidance, and performance data.
Generated ads do not guarantee performance, legal compliance, or platform approval.
Image, video, and voice production may use external services requiring consent, licensing, privacy review, and separate fees.

use_cases.title: Launch a Paid Campaign
use_cases.description: Create platform-compliant ad variations from a product brief, audience definition, offer, and brand voice.

use_cases.title: Iterate from Performance Data
use_cases.description: Find patterns in supplied campaign results and generate focused variants that preserve winning angles.

use_cases.title: Review a Creative Batch
use_cases.description: Turn grounded concepts into a visual review page that clients can compare before production or launch.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Starter Ad Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Create five Meta ad concepts for [product] aimed at [audience]. Use [offer] and this brand voice: [voice]. Ask for missing essentials first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner campaign creation from a short brief

prompt_templates.title: Build Platform Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this product context: [context]. Generate Google, Meta, and LinkedIn variations. Show each angle, character count, CTA, and required disclaimer.

prompt_templates.title: Iterate from Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this ad performance table: [data]. Identify strong and weak patterns. Create twelve controlled variations and state the hypothesis behind each group.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Grounded Creative Cycle
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these winning ads, reviews, comments, and account results: [sources]. Build an evidence-ranked roadmap, production mix, review page plan, and monthly retro framework.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced creative strategy and scaled production

output_examples.input: Create Google Ads headlines for a reporting tool that saves marketing teams ten hours each week.
Review supplied Meta results and propose the next test round.
output: Finding: Specific time-saved claims produced the strongest click-through rate.
Next test: Keep the time-saving angle and compare proof-led, pain-led, and action-led hooks.
Control: Preserve the current offer, audience, format, and landing page.

output_examples.input: Prepare three grounded concepts for client review using customer comments.
output: Concept one addresses the most repeated setup objection and cites the source comment.
Concept two turns an unprompted customer benefit into a proof-led carousel.
Concept three tests a new hook while keeping every product claim documented.

best_practices: Provide platform, audience, offer, product proof, brand voice, and compliance constraints before generation.
Ground claims in current reviews, comments, winning ads, and verified product facts.
Change one major variable per test and preserve a clear hypothesis for every variation group.
anti_patterns: Do not invent statistics, testimonials, endorsements, urgency, or product capabilities.
Do not generate many near-duplicate lines that test wording instead of distinct strategic angles.
Do not upload or publish creative without human review for claims, rights, consent, and platform policy.

faq.question: Which advertising platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The guidance covers Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and X, with detailed limits for common formats.

faq.question: Can it improve existing ads?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide performance data and current creative so it can identify patterns and generate focused iterations.

faq.question: Does it retrieve campaign data automatically?
faq.answer: No. Retrieval requires separately configured platform tools, credentials, and user approval.

faq.question: Can it create images or videos?
faq.answer: It can develop concepts and prompts. Asset generation requires a configured image, video, or voice service.

faq.question: How does it prevent unsupported claims?
faq.answer: Grounded modes require every claim to trace to supplied reviews, comments, winning ads, or verified product facts.

faq.question: Does it guarantee compliant or successful ads?
faq.answer: No. A qualified reviewer must confirm claims, consent, intellectual property, platform rules, and applicable law before publication.
